notes.title: The Real Laser Ball Patch 2
notes.content: I received a few reports of some of the hidden achievements being finicky to unlock, or not triggering when supposed to. This patch fixes those items.

notes.title: The Real Laser Ball Patch 1
notes.content: Patch to correct the issue with the Bomber related achievements not triggering. These should now trigger properly when destroying the correct amount of Bombers.

notes.title: The Real Laser Ball has launched!
notes.content:
The Real Laser Ball has finally launched onto Steam! This game was a joy to create and I hope you all have a blast playing it! I wanted to put up a brief announcement with a few tips and tricks:

[list]
    [*]Turning off the laser will allow you to spin faster. This is good for sharp changes in direction
    [*]You will not survive if you don't use your boost
    [*]You do more damage while boosting
    [*]Upgrade your combo and magnet early to make money faster
    [*]If you upgrade your start level past 50, make sure to upgrade your damage
    [*]Always rewind your VHS tapes before returning them to the rental store
[/list]

I will be watching my twitter (@holmsario), my e-mail (Help@holmsario.com) and the Steam reviews in case any issues pop up.

Have fun!

-Holmsario Josh
